The victory over [[Persikad Depok (2025)|Persikad]] made Garudayaksa compete in the top division for the first time in the team's history, while PSS returned to the top division after a season's absence after defeating [[PSIS Semarang|PSIS]].{{Cite news |last=Charlie |date=2 May 2026 |editor-last=Seprianto |title=Garudayaksa FC Ukir Sejarah, Tiket Liga 1 di Tangan |url=https://rri.co.id/sepak-bola/2384594/garudayaksa-fc-ukir-sejarah-tiket-liga-1-di-tangan |access-date=2 May 2026 |work=Radio Republik Indonesia}}{{Cite web |last=Aditya |first=Lucas |date=3 May 2026 |title=Hantam PSIS 3-0, PSS Promosi ke Super League |url=https://sport.detik.com/sepakbola/liga-indonesia/d-8472574/hantam-psis-3-0-pss-promosi-ke-super-league |access-date=3 May 2026 |website=detikSport |language=id-ID}} The last team to be promoted was [[Isenmulang Kalteng F.C.|Isenmulang Kalteng]] (formerly Adhyaksa Banten) after winning against [[Persipura Jayapura|Persipura]] in the promotion playoff on 8 May 2026, which marked the first season in the top division in the team's history.{{Cite web |last=Arifin |first=Yanu |date=8 May 2026 |title=Playoff Championship: Tekuk Persipura, Adhyaksa FC Promosi ke Super League |url=https://sport.detik.com/sepakbola/liga-indonesia/d-8480697/playoff-championship-tekuk-persipura-adhyaksa-fc-promosi-ke-super-league |access-date=8 May 2026 |website=detikSport |language=id-ID}} [[PSBS Biak|PSBS]] and [[Semen Padang F.C.|Semen Padang]] became the first two teams to be relegated after both spent two seasons in the top division. In the matchweek 31, PSBS suffered a defeat to [[Persebaya Surabaya|Persebaya]] on 2 May 2026 while Semen Padang lost to [[Dewa United Banten F.C.|Dewa United Banten]] on 3 May 2026. The last team to be relegated is [[Persis Solo]] in the final matchweek, despite their win over [[Persita Tangerang|Persita]], in the other match [[Madura United]] defeated [[PSM Makassar]], which caused Persis confirmed relegation, and ended their four seasons in the top division.{{Cite web |last=Mandalika |first=Alfa |date=2 May 2026 |title=Hasil Persebaya vs PSBS Biak: PSBS Biak Terdegradasi Usai Kalah Telak 4-0 di Surabaya |url=https://www.medcom.id/olahraga/liga-indonesia/Gbm0q5eN-hasil-persebaya-vs-psbs-biak-psbs-biak-terdegradasi-usai-kalah-telak-4-0-di-surabaya |access-date=2 May 2026 |website=medcom.id |language=id}}{{Cite web |last=Caniago |first=Halbert |date=3 May 2026 |title=Kalah dari Dewa United, Semen Padang FC Degradasi ke Liga 2 |url=https://sumsel.idntimes.com/sport/soccer/kalah-1-0-dari-dewa-united-semen-padang-fc-degradasi-ke-liga-2-00-6srcb-5gg8cx |access-date=3 May 2026 |website=IDN Times Sumsel |language=id}}{{Cite web |date=23 May 2026 |title=Persis Resmi Degradasi, Ikuti Jejak Semen Padang dan PSBS |url=https://www.cnnindonesia.com/olahraga/20260523182721-142-1361652/persis-resmi-degradasi-ikuti-jejak-semen-padang-dan-psbs |access-date=23 May 2026 |website=CNN Indonesia |language=id-ID}} == Teams == ===Changes=== The following teams changed division since the 2025–26 season. {| class="wikitable" |- ! {{increase}} Promoted from [[2025–26 Championship (Indonesia)|Championship]] ! {{decrease}} Relegated to [[2026–27 Championship (Indonesia)|Championship]] |- | * [[Garudayaksa F.C.|Garudayaksa]] * [[PSS Sleman|PSS]] * [[Isenmulang Kalteng F.C.|Isenmulang Kalteng]]{{efn|formerly Adhyaksa Banten}} | * [[PSBS Biak|PSBS]] * [[Semen Padang F.C.|Semen Padang]] * [[Persis Solo|Persis]] |} Notes: {{notelist}} ===Name changes and relocated teams=== Clubs can no longer relocate their home base once they have obtained an I-League license.
